objective: Reduce wasted vertical space in the shared public mobile dashboard header and Daily Encouragement strip while preserving safe-area handling, readable content, sponsor placement and notification access.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: Android Production OTA run #249 published update 01a1a62f-f53e-7569-a4ef-306df0e0082b on production channel, Android runtime 1.3.2, from source SHA 4ed0d427b54c9ced99dfc0615b19f8cfac8dabab. Main has newer source changes; this scoped UI change remains DEV until exact-head QA and a new RC/OTA.
chosenApproach: Reduce shared header min-height and title size, then tighten Daily Encouragement strip padding and icon dimensions. Keep the status-bar inset additive and preserve all existing actions.
selectionRationale: The screenshot shows excess vertical consumption above the Wall. Shared shell and context bar are the direct sources; a small cross-route reduction improves usable viewport without hiding content.
preserveBehaviors: Safe-area top inset remains fully respected
Notification action and unread badge remain visible and tappable
Sponsor placement and route-specific header behavior remain unchanged
Daily Encouragement verse, language label and reference remain present
No bottom-navigation or feed geometry changes
acceptanceChecks: Shared header minHeight is reduced without removing insets.top
Daily Encouragement shell uses reduced vertical padding and a proportionally smaller icon
Engineering accountability and current-base CI pass
Physical-device verification skipped per user instruction; no device-render claim
alternativeApproaches: Hide Daily Encouragement or notifications (rejected: removes useful functionality)
Remove safe-area padding (rejected: risks status-bar overlap)
Reduce text size aggressively (rejected: harms readability)
